framing.lineOfInquiry: Sunil Sandhu (P00328) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE033
framing.alternate: Sunil Sandhu (P00328) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sunil Sandhu was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 43 other days (16 Apr – 14 Jun), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sunil Sandhu's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: The record placing them near the scene (LOCATION) is only accurate to about 1.2 km

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.

alternateHypotheses.title: The money has a legitimate explanation
alternateHypotheses.statement: The flagged money movements of Sunil Sandhu have an ordinary purpose (salary, rent, property, business) or belong to a co-holder of the account.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Flagged RTGS ₹850,000 on 2025-05-29 13:49 has a stated purpose 'property booking - registered sale deed' — Stated purpose 'property booking - registered sale deed' may be a legitimate explanation; verify supporting documents.

alternateHypotheses.test: Obtain full statements, invoices or agreements and KYC; confirm the stated purpose with the counter-party.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sunil Sandhu was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as complainant, not as accused

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sunil Sandhu's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Balwinder Gill since 2025-04-17, 27 days before the incident (5 calls, 5 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Priya Rana since 2025-04-21, 23 days before the incident (14 calls, 9 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Manoj Bhatia since 2025-04-22, 23 days before the incident (3 calls, 6 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Someone else used the phone or handset

comparison.verdict: Every supporting item could be explained by at least one alternate, although the line of inquiry is stronger on weight (0.79 vs 0.58). Test the alternates before relying on it.
settleWith: A2 — Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).
A8 — Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.
A4 — Obtain full statements, invoices or agreements and KYC; confirm the stated purpose with the counter-party.

confidence.note: Evidential balance compares weighted supporting vs contradicting evidence; it is not a probability of guilt. Prior records are excluded from this score.

note: Each hypothesis is tested from both sides to reduce confirmation bias. Confidence scores are evidential balance (not probability of guilt). Human review is required.
